Description

David Ross Estate Agents, your local property experts, are proud to present new to the market for sale no.8 Ardevin Grove. This magnificent property comes to the market in turn-key condition eagerly awaiting its lucky new owner to turn the key.

Located in Monasterevin, a quiet yet popular town in Co. Kildare, this property would suit anyone looking to escape the hustle and bustle of city life but still have the convenience of the amenities of a small town. Some of these amenities include a GAA club, parks, shops and a gym nearby.

This property really encapsulates modern living, with the downstairs area consisting of bright, open areas which have been tastefully decorated and thought out. This area consists of a living room to the front fitted with a classic feature fireplace which leads you straight into a fully fitted kitchen. The flow and space of the ground floor makes for a fantastic entertaining space rain or shine. A convenient bathroom brings everything together.

To the rear of the property you have a large back garden which again needs little to no work, a magnificent space for enjoying family life or optimising combined with the ground floor for entertaining. There is a shed to the rear with scope for development subject to planning permission.

Upstairs briefly comprises three bedrooms. A double alongside a single to the front aspect and a large double bedroom with a beautiful en-suite bathroom to the rear. A third bathroom completes this floor.

Finally a spacious attic completes this picture perfect property.

The opportunity to acquire such a property in an idyllic location like Monasterevin is a rare one so early viewing would be recommended in order to see everything this property has to offer.
Viewing by appointment only.

Features:
- Semi detached
- Side entrance
- Large garden
- Turn-key condition
- Fantastic location
